verdict.rationale: Pigment is a SaaS platform that advertises open APIs and an Audit Trail API, so this axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence documents API versioning or a deprecation policy. The "v1" heading in the knowledge-base llms.txt labels documentation, not a versioned API contract, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
